landscape_environment.note: Sea shore, small water and mountain waterfall are explicit landscape evidence.

people_social_roles.note: People seeking water, kings, generous patrons, poets and warrior-ruler roles are retained.

relationships.note: Seeking, patron access, gift appeal and praise are explicit relationships.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Desire/thirst analogy and the speaker's inward purpose in coming are retained as lived experience.

food_subsistence.note: Seeking drinking water is retained as explicit subsistence evidence.

weapons_warfare.note: Victorious battle, thrown weapon and courage not to flee are explicit warfare evidence.

mobility_transport.note: Poets travelling toward generous patrons and the speaker's arrival are explicit mobility evidence.

economy.note: Reward/gift (`ஊதியம்`, giving/withholding) and patron-seeking are explicit economy/patronage evidence.

communities_social_groups.note: `புலவர்` are retained as a source literary group.

arts_music_performance.note: Poet role and praise/song of the ruler's mountain are retained as performance evidence.

values_ethical_concepts.note: The difficulty of asking, freedom to give or not give, courage and praise are explicit value/evaluative reasoning.

body_health.note: Thirst/desire for water is retained as body-related need without medical expansion.
